decisions.state_text: On the Party Board: Feral, bear tank. The board names no change at 40.

by.text: No Blizzard date for level 40. Dual spec opens at 40; raids open Dec 9.

lines.label: Dual spec
lines.text: available at level 40; price unpublished (10 gold circulates in community notes)

lines.label: At 40 the trainer has
lines.text: Cower rank 2, Dire Bear Form, Ferocious Bite rank 2, Hurricane rank 1, Innervate, Mark of the Wild rank 5, Moonfire rank 7, Prowl rank 2, Rebirth rank 3, Rejuvenation rank 7, Tranquility rank 2, Wild Growth rank 1

lines.label: New baseline spells
lines.text: Nature's Grasp 10, Revive 12 (out-of-combat resurrection), Omen of Clarity 20, Shred 20 (since Oct 15), Lacerate 42 (Sep 30 deep dive; Oct 15 notes)

lines.label: Bear levels
lines.text: Bear Form, Maul, Growl and Demoralizing Roar at 10 from the class quest; Enrage 12; Bash 14; Swipe 16; Feral Charge 20 (talent); Primal Bite 25 (talent); Challenging Roar 28; Leader of the Pack 30; Frenzied Regeneration 36; Dire Bear Form 40 (Warcraft Tavern); Lacerate 42 (Blizzard)

lines.label: The trade-off
lines.text: Blizzard's summary: no snares, silences or interrupts, weaker crowd control (Sep 30 deep dive)

lines.label: Auras
lines.text: Leader of the Pack (melee and ranged crit) and Moonkin Aura (spell crit) are raid-wide since Oct 15; the Sep 30 text made the two talents exclusive and the Oct 15 notes do not say whether that holds (Sep 30 deep dive; Oct 15 notes)

lines.label: Endurance
lines.text: passive, +5% max health and nothing else since Oct 26 (Oct 15 to Oct 26 it also gave +2% crit damage and healing; before Oct 15, +1% hit)

lines.label: Medals
lines.text: Feral Charge 11 (now with a Cat version), Shifting Power and Primal Bite 16, Leader of the Pack 21, Berserk 31; Balance Nature's Splendor 11, Insect Swarm 16; Restoration Gift of the Earthmother 11, Swiftmend 16, Wild Growth 31; client data adds Nature's Grace, Moonkin Form, Nature's Swiftness (Sep 30 deep dive; client 70450)

lines.label: Primal Bite
lines.text: the renamed Mangle; 20 Rage, very high threat, doubled Oct 1 (Sep 30 deep dive; Oct 1 notes)

lines.label: Berserk
lines.text: 15 s, removes Fear, resets Primal Bite and lets it hit up to 3 targets, +100% crit on Cat combo abilities (Sep 30 deep dive)

lines.label: Frenzied Regeneration
lines.text: can heal 100% of max health with enough Rage (Sep 30 deep dive)

lines.label: Swipe
lines.text: hits 3 targets and scales with Attack Power (Sep 30 deep dive)

lines.label: Thick Hide
lines.text: armor scales with Defense from gear, so bears want the same Defense items as other tanks (Sep 30 deep dive)

lines.label: Bear threat
lines.text: 50% (Oct 8 notes)

lines.label: Full tanks
lines.text: Protection Warrior and Feral Druid (Sep 30 deep dives), Protection Paladin (Oct 15 deep dive); all three have a taunt

lines.label: Wild Growth
lines.text: party HoT every second for 7 s, pets included (Sep 30 deep dive)

lines.label: Swiftmend
lines.text: 16-point medal; no longer consumes Rejuvenation or Regrowth (Sep 30 deep dive)

lines.label: Balance baseline
lines.text: Hurricane has no cooldown; Faerie Fire is free on a 6 s cooldown and castable in Bear and Cat; Entangling Roots works indoors (Sep 30 deep dive)

lines.label: Eclipse
lines.text: Wrath shortens the next 2 Starfires (Sep 30 deep dive)

lines.label: Dual spec

lines.label: At 40 the trainer has
lines.text: Dark Sacrifice rank 3, Fade rank 4, Greater Heal rank 1, Inner Fire rank 4, Mana Burn rank 3, Mind Blast rank 6, Penance rank 2, Prayer of Healing rank 2, Prayer of Mending rank 1, Shackle Undead rank 2, Shadow Word: Death rank 2, Touch of Weakness rank 4

lines.label: Divine Spirit
lines.text: trained at 30; +17 Spirit at rank 1, 1 hour (Sep 30 deep dive; client 70450)

lines.label: Prayer of Healing
lines.text: heals the target's party and their pets at 40 yd (Sep 30 deep dive)

lines.label: Fear Ward
lines.text: every priest at 20; 3 min cooldown, 3 min duration, 100 mana (Sep 30 deep dive; Wowhead tooltip; Classic Dwarf only)

lines.label: Levels
lines.text: Power Word: Shield 6; Renew and Fade 8; Mind Blast, Resurrection and racial spell 1 at 10; Inner Fire 12; Psychic Scream 14; Heal 16; Dispel Magic 18; Flash Heal, Holy Fire, Fear Ward, Devouring Plague, Shackle Undead, Mind Soothe and racial spell 2 at 20; Mana Burn 24; Holy Nova and Mind Flay 28 (unchecked in game); Prayer of Healing, Divine Spirit, Mind Control and Shadow Protection 30; Shadow Word: Death 32; Levitate 34; Greater Heal 40; Prayer of Fortitude 48; Prayer of Shadow Protection 56; Prayer of Spirit 60 (client 70450)

lines.label: Leveling guides
lines.text: beta-time guides describe Discipline with a wand to 39 and Shadowform at 40 as the Shadow payoff; Warcraft Tavern says Shadow does not start shining until 28; Spirit Tap and Penance cannot both fit in 21 points (Method, Oct 4; Warcraft Tavern)

lines.label: Touch of the Grave, by role
lines.text: passive, chance to drain health on hit or spell; Oct 15 (as Touch of the Dead): 30% proc for casters, 20% for Paladin, Rogue and Warrior, 15 s internal cooldown since Oct 27 (25 s from Oct 15), no low-rank penalty; guides say about 5% of max health drained

lines.label: Soul Warding
lines.text: 16-point medal, needs Improved Power Word: Shield; removes the shield cooldown and cuts its cost 15% (Sep 30 deep dive)

lines.label: Penance
lines.text: 21-point medal; 2 s channel, 12 s cooldown, three hits, heals an ally or damages an enemy; rank 1 150 mana, 45 damage or 134 healing per hit after the Oct 8 cut that fixed a 3 s channel bug (Sep 30 deep dive; Oct 8 notes; client 70450; Wowhead rank 1 tooltip)

lines.label: Divine Aegis
lines.text: row 6; non-periodic crit heals leave an absorb worth 15% of the heal, capped at 1,200, 12 s, no stacking (Oct 15 notes)

lines.label: Power Infusion
lines.text: 31 points; +20% spell damage and healing on a target for 15 s, 3 min cooldown (client 70450 only; absent from Blizzard's text)

lines.label: Holy talents
lines.text: Twilight Focus (pushback protection), Divine Fury (-0.5 s on Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, Greater Heal), Inspiration on any non-periodic crit heal, Improved Healing also cheapens Penance and Prayer of Mending, Binding Heal (16 points), Litany of Light, Spiritual Guidance (25% of Spirit to healing, 8% to damage), Prayer of Mending (31 points, needs Spirit of Redemption); Lightwell and Improved Prayer of Healing removed (Sep 30 deep dive)

lines.label: Shadowform
lines.text: allows every non-healing spell, halves Shadow mana costs, +100% crit damage (Sep 30 deep dive)

lines.label: Vampiric Embrace
lines.text: 16-point medal; 30 s duration, 30 s cooldown, unresistable (Oct 15 notes)

lines.label: New Shadow talents
lines.text: Dark Inspiration (row 4: Mind Blast or a full Mind Flay gives the party +15% Spirit for 10 s), Devouring Contagion (spreads to 2 targets), Early Demise, Improved Mind Flay (each tick +20% over the last); Shadow Focus is the row 1 hit talent (Sep 30 deep dive; client 70450)

lines.label: Holy Specialization
lines.text: 5 ranks; rank 1: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 1%.

lines.label: Spirit Tap
lines.text: 5 ranks; rank 1: Gives you a 0% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.

decisions.title: Spec at 40
decisions.state_text: On the Party Board: Retribution to 40, then Ret/Holy.

by.text: No Blizzard date for level 40. Dual spec opens at 40; raids open Dec 9.

lines.label: Dual spec
lines.text: available at level 40; price unpublished (10 gold circulates in community notes)

lines.label: At 40 the trainer has
lines.text: Blessing of Light rank 1, Devotion Aura rank 5, Hammer of Justice rank 3, Hammer of the Righteous, Light's Vigil rank 1, Seal of Light rank 2, Shadow Resistance Aura rank 2

lines.label: Blessing of Kings
lines.text: baseline at 20; 8% of base mana, +10% stats, 1 hour; Improved Wisdom also baseline (client 70450; Oct 15 deep dive)

lines.label: Salvation
lines.text: level 26; Salvation and Mass Salvation replace the Blessing versions, 30% threat reduction, not a Blessing so it sits alongside one; Revoke is new (Oct 15 notes; client 70450)

lines.label: Levels
lines.text: Seal of Righteousness, Holy Light and Devotion Aura 1; Judgement 4; Holy Strike and Divine Protection 6; Hammer of Justice 8; Seal of Fury, Blessing of Protection and Lay on Hands 10; Redemption 12 (quest); Blessing of Wisdom 14; Retribution Aura and Righteous Fury 16; Blessing of Freedom 18; Consecration, Kings, Exorcism and Flash of Light 20; Concentration Aura 22; Salvation and Revoke 26; Divine Intervention and Seal of Light 30; Seal of Wisdom 38; Blessing of Light and Summon Warhorse 40; Cleanse 42; Hammer of Wrath 44; Blessing of Sacrifice 46; Greater Might 52 and Greater Wisdom 54 (Symbol of Kings); Greater Kings, Greater Light and Mass Salvation 60 (client 70450)

lines.label: Mounts
lines.text: the same read marks Summon Warhorse, Summon Charger and Sense Undead as not in Forever, while the wowforevertools 70450 list has Warhorse at 40 and Charger at 60

lines.label: Touch of the Grave, by role
lines.text: passive, chance to drain health on hit or spell; Oct 15 (as Touch of the Dead): 30% proc for casters, 20% for Paladin, Rogue and Warrior, 15 s internal cooldown since Oct 27 (25 s from Oct 15), no low-rank penalty; guides say about 5% of max health drained

lines.label: Champion of the Light
lines.text: 20/40/60% of Intellect after the Oct 18 server hotfix (was 33/66/100 before Oct 1, 20/40/60 after it, 10/20/30 on Oct 15)

lines.label: Retribution Aura
lines.text: back to vanilla base damage, spell power ratio 13.3% to 6% (Oct 8 notes)

lines.label: Leveling reports
lines.text: Wowhead's beta author: 10 to 15 an auto-attack simulator with Holy Strike, threat reliable from Retribution Aura and Righteous Fury at 16, the spec comes online at 20 with Consecration and spell power; Mobalytics (Oct 18) calls Prot a big-pull leveler; Method (Oct 10) and Warcraft Tavern lean Retribution or Holy talents until 20 to 30

lines.label: Holy medals
lines.text: Voice of Truth 11 (6 s immunity to Silence and Interrupt, 3 minute cooldown); Divine Favor 16 (next Flash of Light, Holy Light or Holy Shock a guaranteed crit; was 21); Holy Shock 21 (instant, 10 s cooldown, was 30; rank 1 heals 110 to 118 or hits 129 to 139); Light's Vigil 31 (Oct 15 deep dive; client 70450)

lines.label: Light's Vigil
lines.text: needs Holy Shock; 1.5 s cast, 30 s buff, 6 s cooldown, one per party; the next Holy Shock on that ally skips its cooldown and heals the whole party (325 to 344 at rank 1); on an enemy it hits harder and refunds 75% of its mana (Oct 15 deep dive; client 70450)

lines.label: Other Holy talents
lines.text: Healing Light also boosts Holy Shock; Reverence keeps up to 30% of Spirit regen while casting; Illumination (needs Reverence) refunds 50% of base cost; Infusion of Light cuts the next Holy Light by up to 1 s after a Holy Shock or Flash of Light crit; Divine Precision (needs Holy Shock) up to 18% Holy hit (client 70450)

lines.label: Templar's Bulwark
lines.text: 21-point medal; absorbs 100% of max health for 8 s, 5 minute cooldown, applies Forbearance (Oct 15 deep dive; Wowhead tooltip)

lines.label: Seal of Fury
lines.text: level 10; a Holy hit per swing plus a small absorb that needs a shield and does not stack; rank 7 at 60 hits for 35 plus 10% of spell power; rank 3 at 26; per-swing, so fast weapons get more (Oct 15 deep dive; client 70450)

lines.label: Judgement taunt
lines.text: Judgement with Seal of Fury active taunts for 4 s at 10 yd; rank 7 hits 153 to 167 plus 42.9% of spell power; damage lands before the taunt applies (Oct 15 deep dive; client 70450; beta feedback Oct 5)

lines.label: Swift Judgement
lines.text: 16-point medal; 1 minute cooldown, no mana, ends Judgement's cooldown and makes the next one free (Oct 15 deep dive)

lines.label: Full tanks
lines.text: Protection Warrior and Feral Druid (Sep 30 deep dives), Protection Paladin (Oct 15 deep dive); all three have a taunt
